title: Register injection settings for my own harness
statement: As a harness author or integration contributor, I can register my harness’s injection definition so that my application can use Cordyceps with the binary it already launches, without requiring a bundled integration.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A consumer can register a custom harness definition without contributing it to the bundled registry; Cordyceps does not require discovering, launching or probing the installed binary to prepare its injection settings.

When the consumer applies the definition’s injection settings through its own process setup, the mock backend can capture provider requests and return prescribed responses through the existing library API.
